nodes.label: Privilege Guest Card Back (design export)
nodes.rationale: Design export of the reverse of the same card. A different toolchain than the face export (Inkscape/Scour-style output: 980 clipPaths, 2165 groups, 1475 paths, rgb-percentage stops, zoomAndPan/preserveAspectRatio attrs) and a different internal unit scale (404.88 x 255 user units mapped onto the same 540 x 340 rendered box by a 0.749 gradientTransform), but the same rounded-rect card silhouette and the same 48-stop charcoal ramp as the face. Contains a baked rounded white QR well; no embedded raster images.
